$comment: Pinned scan-surface baseline for the column-type-imports guard (#1769, #2033).
R7: the three mutable sets below are pinned here so that ANY change to
SCANNED_EXTENSIONS, NON_CODE_EXTENSIONS, or EXEMPT_FILES fails the guard
loudly. This closes the three bypasses the r6 reviewer found:
- Hole 1 (exemptions): adding a path to isExempt silently hides a file.
- Hole 2 (justification): a 24-char string of 'a' passes the length bar.
- Hole 3 (extension relocation): moving a scanned extension to non-code
must never keep the real-tree guard green.
The pin makes every one of these gestures visible: the guard compares the
runtime set against the pinned baseline and fails on any divergence.
R11 (#2033): the production guard derives its reference from the
anchored merge-base tree with `git merge-base` and `git ls-tree -r`. A
grow is silent; a shrink below the merge-base count fails loudly.
There are no authored per-extension floors and no slack to maintain.
A legitimate code-file deletion is the only exception. The guard derives
each exact path from the committed merge-base..HEAD Git diff and verifies
that it matches the live disappearance. It never accepts authored deletion
state, counts, directories, globs, or any other form of slack.

nonCodeExtensions..json: static data (e.g. translation files), never imports code
